originalTitle: Embassy Office Parks REIT to enter Nifty 500, become only investment trust in Nifty Midcap 150
simplifiedContent: Embassy Office Parks REIT is going to be added to two important lists of companies in the stock market: the Nifty 500 and the Nifty Midcap 150. This change will happen on September 30, 2026. Being part of these lists may help more people, especially big investors, notice and invest in Embassy Office Parks REIT. This could lead to more activity and interest in the company's stocks. It's a significant development because Embassy Office Parks REIT will be the only investment trust of its kind in the Nifty Midcap 150.

originalTitle: TCS shares tumble 4%, wipe out Rs 35,000 crore after N Chandrasekaran resigns. What should investors do?
simplifiedContent: TCS (Tata Consultancy Services) stock prices dropped by 4% after N Chandrasekaran, the chairman of Tata Sons, resigned. This decrease in stock price resulted in a loss of approximately ₹35,000 crore in the company's market value. Analysts think that the sudden reaction to the news might be an overreaction, which means the stock price might not stay this low. The stock price is expected to find support, or stabilize, around ₹2,000-2,300 and face resistance, or difficulty going higher, around ₹2,670-2,700. This news matters to investors because it affects the value of their TCS shares and may influence their decision on what to do next with their investments.

originalTitle: Lenskart Q1 Results: Profit zooms 182% YoY to Rs 228 crore; revenue up 34%
simplifiedContent: Lenskart, a company that sells eyeglasses and other products, just released its quarterly financial results. The company made a profit of Rs 228 crore, which is 182% more than it made during the same time last year. Its revenue, which is the total amount of money it earned from sales, also increased by 34% to Rs 2,214 crore. This is good news for the company, as it shows that its business is growing and becoming more profitable. The company's strong profit and revenue growth suggests that it is performing well, which could be a positive sign for investors.

originalTitle: Top Gainers & Losers on August 12: TCS, Tata Tech, Redington, Godrej Consumer, Wockhardt among top losers
simplifiedContent: On August 12, the Indian stock market had a bad day, with many big companies' stock prices going down. This happened because the price of crude oil (the oil used to make gasoline) went up, and some important parts of the market, like finance and technology, weren't doing well. As a result, two important measures of the market, called Nifty and Sensex, fell by a small amount, which means the overall value of the market went down. This also means that the market's performance for the month of August is now negative, which is not good news for investors. Overall, it was a tough day for the Indian stock market.

originalTitle: Tata Motors Q1 Results: Net profit surges 83% YoY to  ₹2,560 crore, revenue improves 20%
simplifiedContent: Tata Motors, a big company that makes vehicles, just released its quarterly financial results. The company made a net profit of ₹2,560 crore, which is 83% more than it made during the same time last year. This is a big increase and a good sign for the company. The company's revenue, or the amount of money it made from selling its products, also went up by 20% to ₹20,576 crore. This news matters because it shows that Tata Motors is doing well financially, which can be important for people who have invested in the company or are thinking of doing so.

originalTitle: Small-cap infra stock under  ₹100 jumps 3%, showing resilience against stock market sell-off
simplifiedContent: A small company that works on infrastructure projects and has a low stock price (under ₹100) saw its stock price go up by 3% recently. This is surprising because the overall stock market was doing poorly at the time. The stock started the day at ₹87.99, which was its highest price of the day, showing that investors were still interested in buying it. This increase in price shows that the company's stock is strong and can do well even when the rest of the market is not. The stock's ability to go up in price despite the poor market conditions is a good sign for investors.
